summary_1line: Chyavana foretells the future linking Kusika’s line with the Bhrigus and the rise of Viswamitra and Parashurama, after which Bhishma explains the rewards of penance and gifts.

image_candidates.scene_text: The fiery sage Urva, blazing like the sun, restrains his world-consuming wrath and casts the flame of his anger into the ocean’s Mare’s mouth.
Sage Chyavana stands before King Kusika, foretelling the future births of Viswamitra and Parashurama that will unite the lines of warriors and sages.
The aged Bhishma, lying upon his bed of arrows, instructs the grieving Yudhishthira about penances, gifts, and the rewards awaiting souls after death.
